usedFor: Browse AI collects data from websites, and Moco receives it as a lead through “Create Deal” after each “Table Export”.

bestTemplate.name: “Table Export” in Browse AI, then “Create Deal” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: Scraped rows can become Moco leads, carrying name, contact, company, tags and dates.

watchOut: “Create Deal” in Moco builds a lead from name, contact, company, tags and dates, so map the export columns.
